channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: Inside Italy: The rental scam problem in Italy is real, but they're not always hard to spot
item.description: Apartment hunting in Florence means wading through countless suspicious listings, but editor Clare Speak finds that the scammers at least follow some predictable patterns.

item.title: Inside Spain: The struggle to save up and the darkest January in 30 years
item.description: In this week’s Inside Spain we look at why more than half of Spaniards end the month with less than €50 in all their bank accounts, and how the darkest January in thirty years in mainland Spain has put a damper on the Spanish lifestyle.

item.title: Europe, UK seek closer ties a decade after Brexit
item.description: Ten years after the referendum that led to Brexit, Britain and the European Union must close ranks in an increasingly unstable world, their leaders said on Saturday.

item.title: World should 'take cue' from, not criticise Europe, says Macron
item.description: France's President Emmanuel Macron on Friday defended Europe as an example to follow, as the continent seeks to rebuild strained ties with the United States.

item.title: European debate over nuclear weapons gains pace
item.description: European leaders, worried about threats from a nuclear-armed Russia and doubts about the future of US security commitments, are increasingly debating whether to bolster nuclear arsenals on the continent.

item.title: 200,000 join Iran demonstration in Munich
item.description: About 200,000 people joined a demonstration against the Iranian government in Munich on Saturday, police said, as world leaders gathered nearby for a security conference.

item.title: 'Catastrophic effects': Why Germany is cutting integration courses for foreigners
item.description: Germany has confirmed plans to restrict access to integration courses, citing rising costs and a desire to focus spending on migrants likely to stay long term. Around 130,000 people could be affected – and the consequences could go much further.

item.title: 'You need patience': What it's like to get a residence permit in Germany
item.description: Long waits for appointments, burdensome bureaucracy and language barriers: applying for a residence permit can be a tricky business for foreigners in Germany. We asked readers to share their experience and their top tips.

item.title: Four international night trains from Germany to try in 2026
item.description: Several new night trains will bring passengers from Germany to popular cities around Europe this year, and a couple of popular connections that were set to end are being saved. Here are four exciting overnight journeys to ride this year.

item.title: How to make The Local one of your preferred sources on Google
item.description: Do you like and trust The Local? Then please take a moment to add us as a preferred source on Google to ensure our articles appear in your searches.
